board: Use case: stylized-concept. Production motion sheet for correcting the MagicDesk mechanical selector to match its approved design. Reference image 1 is the approved mechanism identity: a DISTINCT RAISED IVORY PORCELAIN ARCHED COWL on the left front of the base, nickel trim, structural seams, a thick articulated nickel rail with physical hinged smoked-glass plaques. Reference 2 is the authoritative base: preserve its diameter, height, rings, and front controls exactly. Do not turn the cowl into a thin flush metal strip; it must be obviously identifiable as a curved porcelain chamber belonging to the pedestal. No separate hamburger/menu button. The whole cowl is the pressable part; a restrained red slit identifies the latch. Six equal panels, SAME fixed three-quarter camera, SAME base size, close shot of left-front base: 1 SEALED visible ivory cowl with red inset seam; 2 UNLATCH cowl sinks slightly and two real nickel pawls pivot open; 3 DEPLOY cowl halves part around a cavity and telescopic articulated rail extends with plaques still folded; 4 FAN six real smoked glass plaques slowly flip up one after another with amber etched model silhouettes and visibly connected feet; 5 READ one plaque tips into its reader shoe, amber signal travels along rail contact strips; 6 STOW plaques fold down into their stacked lanes, rail retracts, cowl seals. The same six plaques throughout. Keep all hinge connections attached; thick well-made parts, slotted rail walls, pins, gear collars, actual recessed storage. Atomic Heart-inspired retro-futurist material language; physically rendered porcelain, satin nickel, graphite and restrained cherry red. No fireworks or smoke hiding joints. Short English labels only. This is art direction and must not pretend to be engineering verification.
atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual production emissive texture atlas for a retrofuturist mechanical archive and recast animation. A square image divided into an EXACT 2x2 grid of equally sized tiles without any separators, letters, labels or borders. Pure black negative space for additive compositing. Top left: a razor-thin horizontal red-orange scan filament spanning nearly the whole tile width, bright warm-white core, fine irregular energy knots and restrained airy glow, centered vertically. Top right: vertical parallel amber metal-light filaments descending through the whole tile height, fine luminous broken threads and sparse tiny metallic motes, evenly distributed rather than a single explosion. Bottom left: an elegant amber etched rounded rectangular plaque border, luminous corners, fine short registration ticks, empty pure-black central interior, no icons or text. Bottom right: a small warm red optical-emitter aperture glow with bright central point and restrained horizontal anamorphic flare, surrounded by black. High detail, extremely crisp at close range, physically plausible game VFX energy, restrained cinematic bloom; no objects, no base, no rendered environment, no perspective.
